reviews.title: Great App but Ads Hard to Close

There’s a lot of different workouts that you can adjust for yourself - add weights or reps or whatever - and they can all be done at home. That said, the ads are a pain. I don’t mind ads for a free app of course, but the “close” functions on a lot of them won’t work because they are too close to the top of my screen or bleeding off the edge so I have to force quit the app and start over when this happens. Not a huge deal though, still use it daily.

reviews.title: Definitely needs some work.
reviews.text:
I've been using this app for a few weeks now. It wasn't my first choice, but it was free so I thought it'll do. First day I had it, I tried setting a reminder to tell me when to work out, but it kept resetting the time, so I turned off the notifications from the app and set a reminder on my Reminders app in my phone instead. 
Second, there's a pause button at the bottom of the screen, but when I click it to pause, and then again to resume, it always adds extra reps for the exercise that I'm on. 
Third, the ads. This is definitely the biggest problem I have with the app. At the end of every workout when you click 'done' it brings up an ad that you have to click out of to get to the next screen where you put in your weight so you can keep your progress. But instead of navigating out of the ad, it redirected me to the App Store to purchase whatever game it was that was being advertised. The x button in the corner was too small and wasn't working. I tried exiting out of the fitness app and logging back in, but all it made me do was go through the whole workout again. And then the ad popped up and it was the same problem with the exit button being too far in the corner and too small. So I was never actually able to finish putting in my info for after the workout. 
This app is fine enough because it's free, and they have an avatar doing the workout with you so you understand exactly what you're supposed to be doing and for how long. That way you can see the motion and understand what part of the body you're supposed to work out. Sometimes pictures or the names of exercises just isn't enough for me to understand what I'm supposed to be doing. That part of the app is helpful, but in the end it just isn't worth it. I wouldn't recommend this app to anyone else because of the glitches, and it's definitely made me more frustrated when working out.
